adaptations: Imports React for classic JSX compilation; no new dependencies.
Preserves official plane geometry, alternating column speeds, pointer parallax, lift, dim and edge masks.
Adds onSelect(item, index), paused, showTitles, imageFit, imagePosition, ariaLabel, keyboardNavigation.
Adds optional item id, subtitle, objectPosition, imageFit fields; contain portrait fitting and permanent names default on.
Only starts RAF while visible, document visible, not manually paused and not reduced motion; preserves offsets across pause/resume and cleans observers/listeners/RAF.
Reduced motion exposes a static, internally scrollable image grid without continuous RAF.
Visual loop copies are aria-hidden pointer hit targets. A unique keyboard roster is available by default, shown on focus; keyboardNavigation=false delegates access to parent roster.
Clamps requested columns to nonempty item count; fixes stale hover state in inter-tile gaps.
Exposes data-running and data-motion for visual verification.
Official hovered-column pause remains even if pauseOnHover=false; mouseleave resumes that column. pauseOnHover controls whole wall.
Clear stale hover and detached focus when items or motion mode change.
Set plane height to 1.6 times viewport height to cover all loop phases with unequal column lengths.
Remove use client directive from Vite adaptation; original archive unchanged.

checks.browser: Integrated browser checks: portrait pointer click, group filters, profile keyboard access, play/pause, offscreen stop, 1920/1280/390 widths.
